fact: ITEdgeNews reports that the Starlink university connectivity deal aligns with Sierra Leone's National Broadband Strategy for 2023-2028, a period that had not ended; the article gives no event date, so its published date of 2025-01-31 is used.

The Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation held a validation workshop on 28 February 2024 for the National Broadband Strategy (2023-2028); the article does not say the government has adopted it.
